profile.headline: App Analyst III / Patient Portal Administrator
profile.geoLocationName: Egg Harbor, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
2018 AtlantiCare Diversity Champion
2012 Best People, Best Workplace Award Winner
2011 Customer Experience Award Winner

Creative User Interface Designer dedicated to leveraging new and up-to-date web and mobile application technologies.

A firm believer that form and function must go hand-in-hand so that the applications creator and end-users can get the most out of the content and functionality provided.

Constantly growing professionally, researching new web trends to stay on top of new developments and opportunities to increase my company's web visibility and functionality.

My ability to leverage Photoshop, Illustrator as well as a myriad of other creative tools, to rapid prototype web sites or application interfaces shortens the creative process and allows programmers to focus on what they do best.

As successful interface designer and team member, I am entrusted with a numerous of 3rd party application interface designs and modifications on multiple platforms in the healthcare environment.
Commonly asked to work directly with the vendors programming team to decrease turnaround time.

positions.title: Application Systems Analyst III
positions.description: Patient Portal Administrator for 8 years, helping bring a large number of features to the production environment through years of testing and validation.

positions.title: Multimedia & Web Developer
positions.description:
Managing the production, interface and integration of various graphics, video and audio files into packaged designs for use within web templates, presentations or educational materials.

Daily tasks include but are not limited to: video/audio editing, instructional design, author-based programming, creating, editing and maintaining content for display on the web in a variety of formats.
Exercising strong customer relations skills, focusing on building a favorable user experience for external and internal clients.

Website and application User Experience building and maintenance for an array of internal and external applicarions. Creating, translating and applying site templates from proofs provided by our Marketing Department.
Charged with training clients on maintaining their portal pages and web content.
Leveraging responsive design and AngularJS to deliver richer and more flexible user content.

positions.title: Multimedia and Web Developer
positions.description:
Serving as a .NET certified Web Programmer (1 in a team of 4) to find and build solutions in C#, .NET, javascript, jQuery or PHP for AtlantiCare and it's day-to-day needs.  

Advanced knowledge of CSS3 and HTML5 to assist in modifying web-based interfaces to improve functionality and usability of all web applications.

Assisting in the research and development of web-based applications that allow AtlantiCare to better deliver and access data.

Manage incoming site and application requests to determine the best solution for delivery, based on time frame and functionality needed, using one-of-three CMS solutions or a stand alone Web Application.

Oversee and execute web content updates and site creating using three different CMS systems. 2 internal (php and dot-net) and one external (php).

Managing CMS-related user interface testing prior to go live.

Developing and delivering training to other business units on the CMS.  Creating online tutorials for end users as-needed.

Resolving technical issues relating to CMS.

Responsible for training other business users in content management as department-level content administrators.

Collaborate with web strategy and marketing departments to establish best practices for the CMS.

Work with web development team to determine new CMS functionalities and possibilities.

Ensuring all CMS requests fall within our company's branding strategies and color schemes.

Mobile web version creation and framework for all associated AtlantiCare websites.

positions.title: Chairman of the Board
positions.description:
As Chairman of the Board of Directors and an avid  volunteer, I attend all BOD meetings and assist the Executive Director for PAL in all forms of financial decisions, program selections and fundraising opportunities.

The primary goal of the Police Athletic League is providing local youths (and their families) with the opportunity to build lasting relationships with law enforcement officials in our area and creating a level of trust in our community through our programs.

I also serve as the Web/IT Manager maintaining the EHT PAL website and consulting in all forms of Marketing and Web-based information.


During the summer months, I frequently use my vacation days to assist PAL by chaperoning some of the Summer Camp field trips and driving the PAL van.

I take a great deal of pride in being able to give back to my community in any way possible.

company.name: Egg Harbor Township Police Athletic League

positions.title: Route Salesman / Account Manager
positions.description:
Customer Service and Route Salesman for 5+ years winning numerous awards for service and sales.
Received the Aramark award for "Lowest Lost Business in a calendar year".
Received Aramark's National Award for Customer Service recognition. (Voted on by your customers and management team.)
Promoted to Route Salesman trainer after 5 years due to my consistently high customer satisfaction rating.
Promoted to Account Manager after 7 years.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science / Multimedia and Web Design

volunteerExperiences.description:
I began as a volunteer for AC Habitat by offering my services as a Web Developer recreating their web page and bringing them up to speed by setting them up with a PayPal account and creating their first online registration/payment system.

This assisted them greatly in their Annual Golf Tournament and cut man hours in half during the registration process. 

Prior to this they we were still using printed registration forms, faxes and USPS mail to receive their donations and registrations.

I also trained a handful of other volunteers on how to update these web pages as the site I created was based on a content management system.

volunteerExperiences.role: Volunteer, Board Member and Chairman of the Board
volunteerExperiences.companyName: Egg Harbor Township Police Athletic League
volunteerExperiences.description:
Web/Multimedia Development:
I began working with the Police Athletic League by redesigning their existing, standard-HTML website in a content management system.

At the time, all of the information on their site was outdated showing old information without any current information for the events and services they were offering.

Although they were paying $1200+ per year for an online payment system, no one in the organization knew how to use it and they were doing 90% of their registrations and payments via fax and in-person registration.  This also required a large amount of manual data entry for their office staff.

Once I had their new site created, we were able to update all of the content showing current offerings and events and take online payments using their new PayPal account.  We are now also able to display full photo galleries and embedded videos from past events to help sell their programs to the community.

In their first year of taking online payments through the new website, they increased their registrations by 200%.

Graphic Designer:
I also designed multiple logos and a brand new mascot for the organization.  "Buddy the Bulldog" now adorns over 5 different logos and is used in most of their team merchandising.  The design is now copyright owned by EHT PAL.

Muralist:
A new building that was erected a few years ago was named "Area 51" by the PAL Aeronautics team.  I painted a large mural in the main room depicting our mascot "Buddy" in a space encounter suit playing paintball with a group of aliens.

Coloring Book:
One of the other projects I'm creating for the organization is a coloring/activity book aimed at elementary school youths.  "Buddy's Adventures" is an activity book that we will be looking to have area sponsors help us publish and distribute to area schools.
